question: Should this release-workflow PR retain ownership of the Apple locale refresh already proposed in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/110362, or should the locale PR land independently before this branch is rebased?
rationale: Both branches modify the same generated locale surface, while the workflow PR has a separate release-automation purpose; choosing the permanent ownership and landing order requires release-workflow intent.

options.title: Separate the locale refresh
options.body: Land or close the dedicated locale-refresh PR first, remove its generated delta from this branch, and rebase the focused workflow change afterward.

options.title: Explicitly combine the work
options.body: Keep the locale delta here only if the release-workflow owner explicitly accepts this PR as the single owner and closes the overlapping locale PR.

recommendation.title: Separate the locale refresh
recommendation.body: Land or close the dedicated locale-refresh PR first, remove its generated delta from this branch, and rebase the focused workflow change afterward.

likelyOwner.reason: The available commit history ties this contributor most directly to the release-workflow changes and branch composition.
